title: Taxation Related Terms And Terminologies
definition: An exhaustive compendium of fiscal, legal, and economic terms associated with tax structures, administrative mechanisms, incidence, and policy frameworks in India's public finance architecture.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for answering core conceptual questions in Prelims (GS-1/Economy) regarding tax incidence, progressivity, avoidance vs. evasion, and analytical questions in Mains (GS-III) on fiscal federalism, resource mobilization, and tax reforms.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Taxation Related Terms And Terminologies.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basics of Indian Economy and Fiscal Policy
Articles 265 to 300A of the Constitution of India
